conditioning: Every replan uses recorded real images and measured state from this validation episode, not model-generated simulation observations; last forecast fills final 50 steps.
limitations: Same collection session and validation episode previously used for monitoring; exact unseen physical start and object pose not established.
Model does not control simulation: kinematic targets are plotted.
Recorded real observations are supplied at each replan; this is teacher-forced, not closed loop.
IK targets precede driver safety processing; no commands sent to hardware.

initial_joint_pose_comparison.metric: L2 distance over 14 arm joints excluding grippers, radians; no wrapping or geometric calibration
initial_joint_pose_comparison.warning: measurement difference does not establish an independently designed start, object pose variation, or out-of-distribution state

hold_warning: hold at replan anchor is the like-for-like input cadence baseline; hold every recorded frame uses more frequent observations
